title: After the Takarazuka Kinen: Helming the Ship

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ines Fujin has the time of her life racing against her rival at the Takarazuka Kinen. Relishing the feel of the breeze, all she wants to do is run some more—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That is, until she sees Mejiro Ryan expressing her gratitude to the crowd. Scrambling to thank her own fans too, Ines promises to keep working hard to live up to their expectations.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She tells me that she hopes to make her next race another that will make her supporters happy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no doubt in my mind that what her fans really want is to see her having a great time on the track, and the autumn Tenno Sho is a race she'll definitely enjoy!
